pib.headline: 99 priority irrigation projects completed under PMKSY-AIBP
pib.summary: Jal Shakti Ministry announces completion of 99 priority irrigation projects under Accelerated Irrigation Benefits Programme, irrigating 76 lakh hectares.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
pib.summary: The release describes PMKSY's components and reports that continuation of the HKKP component for 2021–26 was approved. It sets targets of creating 4.5 lakh hectares of irrigation potential through surface minor irrigation and repair, renovation and restoration of water bodies, alongside coverage of 30.23 lakh hectares under CAD&WM.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
pib.summary: The release reports that PMKSY implementation for 2021–22 to 2025–26 was approved with an overall outlay of ₹93,068.56 crore, including ₹37,454 crore in central assistance. It also states that 14,966 water-harvesting structures were created or rejuvenated and about 18,033 hectares were brought under irrigation in West Bengal under the Watershed Development component during 2015–2023.

pib.headline: Year End Review – Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
pib.summary: The year-end review reports progress under the PMKSY-Har Khet Ko Pani component in 2023. It states that 29,777 wells were constructed, 87,243 hectares of command area were created, and 67,902 small and marginal farmers benefited.

pib.headline: Cabinet approves inclusion of Kosi Mechi Intra-State Link Project of Bihar under Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana-Accelerated Irrigation Benefits Programme (PMKSY-AIBP)
pib.summary: The Cabinet approved inclusion of Bihar's Kosi Mechi Intra-State Link Project under PMKSY-AIBP, with an estimated project cost of ₹6,282.32 crore and central support of ₹3,652.56 crore. The project is expected to provide 2,10,516 hectares of additional annual Kharif-season irrigation in four Bihar districts.

pib.headline: Cabinet approves Modernization of Command Area Development and Water Management as a sub-scheme of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana for the period 2025-2026

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
pib.summary: The release provides an update on PMKSY implementation and notes that underground distribution pipelines totaling about 55,290 km helped avoid acquiring approximately 76,594 hectares of land. pib.headline: Projects Approved under (M-CADWM)

pib.headline: Modernisation of Command Area Development and Water Management

pib.headline: Jan Dhan: 46.25 crore accounts, Rs 1.74 lakh crore deposits
pib.summary: Finance Minister announces 46.25 crore Jan Dhan accounts with combined deposits of Rs 1.74 lakh crore. 56% account holders are women.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) - National Mission for Financial Inclusion, completes nine years of successful implementation

pib.headline: 52.81 crore PM Jan-Dhan accounts with deposit balance of Rs. 2,30,792 crore opened as on 19.07.2024 under PMJDY
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that 52.81 crore Jan-Dhan accounts had been opened under PMJDY as of 19 July 2024, with deposits totaling Rs. 2,30,792 crore. Women held 55.6% of these accounts, while 66.6% were located in rural and semi-urban areas.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — National Mission for Financial Inclusion — completes a decade of successful implementation
pib.summary: PMJDY completed ten years, with more than 53.14 crore beneficiaries brought into the formal banking system. Deposits in PMJDY accounts reached Rs. 2,31,236 crore, and 36.14 crore RuPay cards had been issued as of 14 August 2024.

pib.headline: Driving Financial Empowerment
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance highlighted PMJDY as a major financial-inclusion initiative, reporting more than 54.58 crore accounts and deposits of Rs. 2.46 lakh crore by January 2025. The release also noted growth in insurance, pension, and entrepreneurship schemes supporting financial security and inclusive growth.

pib.headline: Special campaigns have been launched for enrolling individuals under various financial inclusion Schemes
pib.summary: The government reported that 54.58 crore Jan-Dhan accounts had been opened as of 15 January 2025, including 30.37 crore accounts held by women. It also described special campaigns, banking correspondents, and digital banking units intended to expand access to financial inclusion and credit-linked schemes.

pib.headline: A total of 55.02 crore Jan-Dhan accounts have been opened till 7th March 2025
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance stated that 55.02 crore Jan-Dhan accounts had been opened by 7 March 2025, of which 36.63 crore were in rural and semi-urban areas. The release also reported progress under related insurance, pension, Mudra, and Stand-Up India financial-inclusion schemes.

cag.finding: Payment of financial assistance and pensions to beneficiaries continued through bearer cheques at the time of audit despite the Jan Dhan Scheme being implemented in Meghalaya, under which beneficiaries could open basic savings bank deposit accounts through bank branches or Business Correspondent outlets.
cag.parameter: Payment channel for social assistance and pensions
cag.actual: Bearer-cheque payments continued at the time of audit despite implementation of the Jan Dhan Scheme.

verdict.name: Jan Dhan Yojana
verdict.summary: 1 major CAG finding indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.

scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
scheme.renamedFrom: Self Employment and Talent Utilization (SETU) Scheme
scheme.description: Provides loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Three products: Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k-5L), Tarun (5L-10L).
scheme.goals: Fund the unfunded. Provide institutional finance to micro/small business sector. Target 2.44 crore MSMEs by 2017-18.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Small and micro enterprises, self-employed individuals

pib.headline: PM Mudra: 19.27 crore accounts opened, women get 75% loans
pib.summary: Ministry reports 19.27 crore loan accounts opened under PMMY. Women entrepreneurs constitute 75% of beneficiaries.

pib.headline: MUDRA loans: Rs 15.10 lakh crore disbursed in 6 years
pib.summary: Finance Minister announces that over 28.68 crore MUDRA loans worth Rs 15.10 lakh crore disbursed since inception, helping micro enterprises.

pib.headline: 6,23,10,598 loans sanctioned under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) in FY 2022-23
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance stated that 6,23,10,598 PMMY loans were sanctioned in FY 2022-23, compared with 5,37,95,526 in FY 2021-22. The scheme provides collateral-free institutional credit of up to Rs. 10 lakh to eligible micro and small enterprises.

pib.headline: FEMALE LABOUR FORCE PARTICIPATION RATE (LFPR) ROSE TO 37 PER CENT IN 2022-2023 FROM 23.3 PER CENT IN 2017-2018
pib.summary: The Economic Survey 2023-24 reported that around 68 percent of loans sanctioned under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana had gone to women entrepreneurs as of May 2024. The release presented this figure alongside broader indicators of women's financial and economic empowerment.
pib.figureUnit: percent of PMMY loans sanctioned to women

pib.headline: Loan limit under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) increased to Rs.20 lakh from the current Rs.10 lakh
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance announced that the PMMY loan limit was increased from Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 20 lakh. A new Tarun Plus category was introduced for borrowers who had successfully repaid previous Tarun loans, with guarantee coverage provided through the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana Loan Limit Raised to ₹20 Lakh from ₹10 Lakh
pib.summary: The release reiterated that the PMMY loan ceiling had been raised to ₹20 lakh from ₹10 lakh, effective October 24, 2024. It also described the Tarun Plus category for eligible repeat borrowers and the expanded guarantee coverage under CGFMU.

pib.headline: A Decade of Growth with PM Mudra Yojana Fueling grassroots entrepreneurship and expanding financial inclusion
pib.summary: The release marked ten years of PMMY and stated that the scheme had sanctioned over 52 crore loans worth ₹32.61 lakh crore since its launch. It highlighted the scheme's role in expanding institutional credit access for non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, including women-led businesses.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) — completes 10 glorious Years of empowering Small and Micro Entrepreneurs
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance stated that PMMY had extended more than 52.37 crore loans amounting to over ₹33.65 lakh crore during its first decade. The release also noted that the scheme provides collateral-free loans of up to ₹20 lakh, including through the newly introduced Tarun Plus category.

verdict.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (BJP era continuation)
scheme.description: Continuation and implementation of the MGNREGS Act under BJP government. Provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year to adult members of rural households who demand unskilled manual work.
scheme.goals: Provide 100 days of employment to all rural households demanding work. Strengthen livelihood security of rural poor. Create durable assets. Empower rural women.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: 5-8 crore rural households annually demanding work

pib.headline: MGNREGS: 7.55 crore households provided employment in 2020-21
pib.summary: Rural Development Ministry announces record 7.55 crore rural households given employment under MGNREGS in 2020-21, generating 389.09 crore person-days of work.

pib.headline: MGNREGS wages hiked: workers to get Rs 267/day average nationally
pib.summary: Government announces average MGNREGS wages hiked to Rs 267 per day, benefiting 5 crore rural households annually.

pib.headline: Increase in MGNREGS Funds
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that employment demand under Mahatma Gandhi NREGS reached 6.90 crore households in FY 2022-23, with 6.89 crore households offered employment as of March 31, 2023. The revised allocation for FY 2022-23 was increased to Rs. 89,400 crore from the budget estimate of Rs. 73,000 crore.

pib.headline: Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Shri Giriraj Singh briefs media and launches brochures on “9 Years’ achievements of Rural Development”
pib.summary: The Minister said there was no deficit of funds under MGNREGS and that additional funds had been sought from the Ministry of Finance. The release also reported that 2,644 crore person-days had been generated under NREGA during the preceding nine years, with more than Rs. 6.63 lakh crore released as the central share.

pib.headline: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme ensuring 100 days of wage employment for rural households
pib.summary: The release reiterates that Mahatma Gandhi NREGS provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work. It reported 25.68 crore registered workers in FY 2023-24 and 25.17 crore registered workers as of November 29, 2024, in FY 2024-25.

pib.headline: Year End Review 2024: Achievement of the Department of Rural Development
pib.summary: The Department reported that 196.30 crore person-days were generated under MGNREGA in FY 2024-25 through December 11, 2024. The release highlighted digital and monitoring interventions including NMMS, GeoMGNREGA, the Aadhaar Payment Bridge System and the JALDOOT App.

pib.headline: Removal of workers from Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
pib.summary: The Ministry stated that deletion or updating of job cards is conducted by States and Union Territories, which must ensure that eligible households are not removed. It reported that 86,17,887 active workers were deleted or cancelled in FY 2022-23 and 68,86,532 in FY 2023-24 for reasons including fake or duplicate cards and permanent relocation.

pib.headline: RURAL DISTRESS SHOWCASED BY RISE IN HOUSEHOLDS UNDER MGNREGS
pib.summary: The release describes MGNREGS as a demand-driven scheme providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment. It also reports that Project UNNATI had trained 82,799 MGNREGS workers as of December 31, 2024, against a project objective of training 2 lakh workers.

pib.headline: REFORMS IN MGNREGS
pib.summary: The Ministry said MGNREGS is implemented through the NREGASoft transaction-based management information system, covering job cards, work approvals, muster rolls, measurements and DBT payments. The release also described monitoring and evaluation arrangements intended to strengthen transparency, accountability and proper use of funds.

pib.headline: APP-BASED ATTENDANCE SYSTEM
pib.summary: The Ministry stated that attendance at MGNREGS worksites is to be captured through the NMMS App using two time-stamped, geo-tagged photographs per day, subject to specified exceptions. Attendance captured through the app reached 95.21% in the first fortnight and 96.37% in the second fortnight of FY 2024-25 to date.

pib.headline: Effective implementation of Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme in the current decade
pib.summary: The release compared MGNREGA performance before and after 2014, reporting 3,029 crore person-days generated between FY 2014-15 and FY 2024-25, versus 1,660 crore in the preceding period. It also stated that Rs. 7,81,302 crore had been released during FY 2014-15 to FY 2024-25, resulting in the creation of 8.07 crore rural assets.

pib.headline: Expanding Scope of Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
pib.summary: The Ministry explained that Scheduled Tribe households in forest areas meeting specified conditions can receive an additional 50 days of wage employment beyond the standard 100 days. It also noted that up to 50 additional days may be provided in drought- or natural-calamity-affected notified rural areas.

pib.headline: Fund for Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
pib.summary: The Ministry reported a budget allocation of Rs. 86,000 crore for MGNREGS in FY 2024-25, describing it as the highest budget-estimate allocation since the scheme began. The same allocation was retained for FY 2025-26, with additional funds to be sought when required by employment demand.

pib.headline: WORKING OF MGNREGS
pib.summary: The Ministry described MGNREGS as a demand-driven wage employment scheme providing livelihood security to rural households when better employment is unavailable. It stated that pending and admissible liabilities up to FY 2023-24 had been released to the States and Union Territories, while providing state-wise person-day and wage-fund data through March 2025.

pib.headline: ISSUES RELATING TO WAGES UNDER MGNREGS
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that more than 96% of fund transfer orders had consistently been generated within 15 days of muster-roll closure during the previous five financial years. It also stated that all pending wage liabilities up to FY 2024-25 had been cleared and that wage payments are made directly through DBT.
pib.figureUnit: percent of FTOs generated within 15 days

pib.headline: Cancellation Of Fake Job Cards Under MGNREGS
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that 759,362 fake job cards were deleted in FY 2022-23, 289,626 in FY 2023-24 and 58,826 in FY 2024-25. It stated that States and Union Territories are primarily responsible for investigating and taking action against irregularities in scheme implementation.

pib.headline: EMPLOYMENT GENERATION UNDER MGNREGA
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that 3.83 crore households availed themselves of MGNREGS employment in FY 2025-26 as of July 21, 2025. During the same period, the scheme generated 106.77 crore person-days, alongside measures intended to improve timely wage payments.

pib.headline: BUDGET ALLOCATION UNDER MGNREGA
pib.summary: The release listed budget estimates, revised estimates and funds released under MGNREGS for the previous five financial years. It stated that Rs. 86,000 crore was allocated for FY 2024-25 and retained for FY 2025-26, while 99.79% of eligible rural households had been offered employment against their demand as of July 22, 2025.
pib.figureUnit: percent of eligible households offered employment

cag.finding: Per rural household employment declined from 54 days in 2009-10 to 43 days in 2011-12.
cag.parameter: Per rural household employment generation

cag.finding: Non-identification of beneficiaries by Gram Panchayats led to non-implementation of 88.73 per cent of individual projects included in the Annual Plan.
cag.parameter: Implementation of individual beneficiary projects
cag.unit: percent of Annual Plan individual projects not implemented

cag.finding: Demand for employment from registered households did not exceed 48 per cent of the issued job cards during the audit period.
cag.parameter: Household demand for MGNREGS employment

cag.finding: Although the scheme provides for 100 days of guaranteed employment, households provided employment received an average of 21 days per household per year during 2019-24.
cag.parameter: Employment days provided per household

cag.finding: Pending liabilities of wages and material amounted to ₹1,217.05 crore.
cag.parameter: Pending wage and material liabilities

verdict.name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (BJP era continuation)
verdict.summary: Severe accountability failure: 3 critical findings by CAG. Significant gap between stated goals and ground reality.

scheme.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
scheme.description: Accident insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death and full disability, Rs 1 lakh for partial disability at a premium of Rs 12/year.
scheme.goals: Provide affordable insurance to those excluded from formal insurance. Target coverage of 10 crore people by 2020.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Bank account holders aged 18-70

pib.headline: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana: 28.37 crore active subscribers
pib.summary: Finance Ministry announces PMSBY has 28.37 crore active subscribers providing Rs 2 lakh accidental insurance at Rs 12/year premium.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), PMJJBY and APY complete 8 years of providing social security cover
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that the three Jan Suraksha schemes had expanded affordable insurance and pension coverage. PMSBY had recorded about 34.2 crore enrolments by 26 April 2023.

pib.headline: 1,19,224 claims paid under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) scheme
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance stated that PMSBY is available to bank and post-office account holders aged 18 to 70 years. As of 28 June 2023, insurers had paid 1,19,224 claims and rejected 30,549 claims since the scheme began.

pib.headline: Driving Financial Empowerment
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance highlighted progress in financial inclusion and insurance coverage. PMSBY had covered 49.12 crore people, with ₹2,994.75 crore processed against accident claims.

pib.headline: A total of 55.02 crore Jan-Dhan accounts have been opened; cumulative PMSBY enrolment is 50.30 crore
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that cumulative PMSBY enrolment reached 50.30 crore as of 7 March 2025. The release also described PMSBY’s accidental death and disability cover of up to ₹2 lakh at an annual premium of ₹20.

pib.headline: Three Jan Suraksha Schemes complete 10 years of providing social security cover
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance marked the tenth anniversary of PMSBY, PMJJBY and APY. PMSBY had recorded more than 51.06 crore enrolments and paid ₹3,121.02 crore for 1,57,155 claims as of 23 April 2025.

pib.headline: Nationwide Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign sees significant progress in the first month
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that the campaign organized nearly 1 lakh camps during its first month to expand access to financial-inclusion schemes. These camps generated 12,36,548 new PMSBY enrolments and helped settle claims under PMJJBY and PMSBY.

pib.headline: Financial Inclusion is Government’s Key Priority; Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign reaches 2.7 lakh Panchayats and ULBs
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reiterated that PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death or total permanent disability and ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability at a ₹20 annual premium. It also announced grassroots campaigns across 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies and a Jansuraksha portal for scheme information.

pib.headline: Nationwide Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign sees significant progress
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that more than 2.3 lakh camps had been organized during the campaign’s first two and a half months. The campaign produced 1.56 crore fresh PMSBY enrolments between 1 July and 14 September 2025.

pib.headline: DFS successfully concludes the four-month Nationwide Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign
pib.summary: The Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, reported that the campaign concluded after organizing 2,67,345 camps across villages and towns. It recorded 2.86 crore fresh PMSBY enrolments and 92,066 claims settled under PMJJBY and PMSBY.

pib.headline: Government takes measures to increase enrolment and ensure timely disbursement of benefits under PMJJBY
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance described measures to improve enrolment and claim payments under PMJJBY and PMSBY, including grassroots campaigns and the Jansuraksha portal. A nationwide saturation campaign was conducted across 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies from July through October 2025.

pib.headline: Government strengthens financial inclusion ecosystem through flagship schemes
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that PMSBY had reached 57.11 crore cumulative enrolments as of 25 February 2026. The release restated that the scheme provides one-year accidental cover of ₹2 lakh for death or permanent total disability and ₹1 lakh for permanent partial disability.

cag.finding: The State provided enhanced benefits of ₹2 lakh under PMJJBY and PMSBY to Anganwadi Workers and Anganwadi Helpers despite the Government of India notification issued in July 2018.
cag.parameter: PMSBY insurance benefit provided to Anganwadi Workers and Anganwadi Helpers
cag.actual: Enhanced benefit of ₹2 lakh was provided despite the July 2018 Government of India notification.

cag.finding: During the beneficiary survey, 44.01 per cent of beneficiaries were not enrolled in any of the insurance schemes, including PM Suraksha Bima Yojana, indicating that the State had not fulfilled its responsibility to sensitise and enrol job-card holders.
cag.parameter: Insurance coverage of MGNREGS workers
cag.actual: 44.01 per cent of surveyed beneficiaries were not enrolled in any insurance scheme.

verdict.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
verdict.summary: 2 major CAG findings indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.

scheme.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
scheme.description: Life insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh cover on death from any cause at a premium of Rs 330/year, renewable annually.
scheme.goals: Provide life insurance to those excluded from formal insurance sector. Target coverage of 5 crore people.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Bank account holders aged 18-50

pib.headline: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana: 12.76 crore active subscribers
pib.summary: Finance Ministry announces PMJJBY has 12.76 crore life insurance subscribers. Claims of Rs 12,500 crore settled since inception.

pib.headline: DFS Secretary chairs meeting with Chief Secretaries to boost enrolments under PMJJBY & PMSBY during the 3-month long campaign
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance launched a three-month campaign covering all districts from April 1 to June 30, 2023, to increase enrolment in PMJJBY and PMSBY at the Gram Panchayat level. At the time, PMJJBY had 8.3 crore active enrolments, while claims of about Rs. 15,500 crore had been paid under both schemes.

pib.headline: DFS Secretary Dr. Vivek Joshi chairs review meeting on progress of Financial Inclusion Schemes with heads of PSBs and senior executives of NABARD, SIDBI, Mudra Ltd. and NPCI
pib.summary: The Department of Financial Services reviewed progress under PMJJBY and other financial-inclusion schemes with public-sector banks and financial institutions. The meeting emphasized fulfilling scheme targets and monitoring the Jan Suraksha saturation campaign conducted across Gram Panchayats from October 1 to December 31, 2023.

pib.headline: Three Jan Suraksha Schemes - Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) complete 10 years of providing social security cover
pib.summary: The three Jan Suraksha schemes completed ten years of providing affordable insurance and pension coverage. As of April 23, 2025, PMJJBY had more than 23.63 crore cumulative enrolments and had paid Rs. 18,397.92 crore in claims.

pib.headline: Nationwide Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign sees a Significant Progress
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported progress in a nationwide campaign to expand access to PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY and PMJDY. Among the reported activities, 1,83,225 new PMJJBY enrolments were recorded through camps conducted since July 1, 2025.

pib.headline: Financial Inclusion is Government’s Key priority; Flagship schemes provide affordable insurance and health protection for all, including SC, ST, and OBCs
pib.summary: The release highlights PMJJBY as an affordable life-insurance scheme offering coverage for death from any cause to eligible people aged 18–50. It states that the scheme provides Rs. 2 lakh of insurance coverage for an annual premium of Rs. 436 and describes measures to expand outreach through grassroots campaigns and the Jan Suraksha portal.

cag.finding: For Pradhanmantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, ₹148.00 crore was allotted during 2017-22, but only ₹8.77 crore was expended, covering 204,843 beneficiaries.
cag.parameter: BOCW fund allotment and expenditure under PMJJBY

cag.finding: The State offered enhanced PMJJBY and PMSBY benefits of ₹2 lakh to Anganwadi Workers and Anganwadi Helpers despite the Government of India notification issued in July 2018.
cag.parameter: Insurance benefits for Anganwadi Workers and Anganwadi Helpers

verdict.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
verdict.summary: 2 major CAG findings indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.

scheme.name: Stand Up India
scheme.description: Scheme to facilitate bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
scheme.goals: Promote entrepreneurship among SC/ST communities and women. Target 2.5 lakh beneficiaries (one per bank branch) by 2019.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: SC/ST entrepreneurs and women borrowers

pib.headline: Stand Up India: 1.68 lakh accounts sanctioned Rs 40,700 crore loans
pib.summary: Finance Ministry celebrates 6 years of Stand Up India. 1,68,743 loan accounts sanctioned with Rs 40,700 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.

pib.headline: Government Has Taken Various Initiatives to Promote Entrepreneurship Across Different Sections of Society
pib.summary: The release states that the Stand-Up India Scheme has been extended through 2025 and facilitates loans of Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore for greenfield enterprises owned by SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs. As of June 2024, more than 2.35 lakh loans had been facilitated nationally, including 0.22 lakh loans sanctioned in Tamil Nadu.

pib.headline: 9 Years of Stand-Up India: Turning Aspirations into Achievements
pib.summary: The Stand-Up India Scheme has sanctioned Rs. 61,020.41 crore since its launch, as of 17 March 2025. The release highlights growth in sanctioned loans and accounts among SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs.

pib.headline: Stand-Up India Scheme Provides Financial and Institutional Aid to the Marginalized
pib.summary: Between April 2022 and March 2025, the Stand-Up India Scheme sanctioned 126,508 loans totaling Rs. 28,996.15 crore to SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs. The scheme also provided guidance, training, mentorship, and links to skilling and entrepreneurship-support institutions.

verdict.name: Stand Up India
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: e-SHRAM Portal
scheme.description: National database of unorganised workers to facilitate their access to social security benefits. Provides a Universal Account Number to each registered unorganised worker.
scheme.goals: Register 38 crore unorganised workers on e-SHRAM portal by 2022. Provide Rs 2 lakh accidental insurance cover. Enable targeted delivery of social security benefits.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: 38 crore unorganised sector workers across India

pib.headline: e-SHRAM portal: 28 crore unorganised workers registered in one year
pib.summary: Labour Ministry celebrates one year of e-SHRAM portal with 28 crore unorganised worker registrations. Women constitute 52% of registrants.

pib.headline: e-Shram portal showcased during 112th International Labour Conference at Geneva, Switzerland
pib.summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment showcased the e-Shram portal and its integrations at the 112th International Labour Conference. More than 29.67 crore unorganised workers had registered by 18 May 2024, and the Ministry said it was developing e-Shram as a one-stop solution for accessing social security schemes.

pib.headline: More than 29.79 Crore Unorganized Workers have been registered on eShram Portal
pib.summary: The release states that more than 29.79 crore unorganised workers, including migrant workers, had registered on e-Shram and received e-Shram cards as of 16 July 2024. It also highlights Aadhaar-verified registration and integrations with the National Career Service, PM-SYM, Skill India Digital and myScheme portals.

pib.headline: E-SHRAM PORTAL
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that more than 30.40 crore unorganised workers had registered on e-Shram as of 19 November 2024. The release also noted an average of about 60,000 registrations per day in October 2024 and described integrations with employment, pension, skills and government-scheme platforms.

pib.headline: Benefits under E-Shram Card
pib.summary: The release states that more than 30.42 crore unorganised workers had registered on e-Shram as of 26 November 2024. It describes the portal’s integrations with employment, pension, skills and welfare platforms, and notes the launch of the e-Shram One-Stop-Solution on 21 October 2024.

pib.headline: E-Shram: One Stop Solution for Unorganised Workers; Over 30.58 Crore Unorganised Workers Registered on e-Shram Portal
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that more than 30.58 crore unorganised workers had registered on e-Shram as of 28 January 2025. During 2024, the portal recorded more than 1.23 crore registrations, while 12 schemes had been integrated or mapped and the portal had become available in 22 Indian languages.

pib.headline: e-SHRAM ONE STOP SOLUTION
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that more than 30.94 crore unorganised workers had registered on e-Shram as of 17 July 2025, including more than 85.86 lakh workers in Andhra Pradesh. The release said that 14 central social-security and welfare schemes had been integrated or mapped with e-Shram.

pib.headline: Social Security for Gig and Platform Workers
pib.summary: The release describes the e-Shram Aggregator Module, launched on 12 December 2024 to register aggregators and the platform workers engaged by them. It states that 12 major aggregators had been onboarded and explains that the portal is being used to support registration and social-security measures for gig and platform workers.

cag.finding: The number of transactions peaked in 2021-22 primarily because of 16.57 crore e-Shram registrations for the informal workforce; however, the effectiveness of the Common Service Centres 2.0 platform was constrained by incomplete integration of State e-services.
cag.parameter: e-SHRAM registrations and integration of State e-services
cag.actual: Incomplete integration of State e-services constrained effectiveness

cag.finding: The Board had data for only 2,51,385 workers, whereas cross-verification with the e-Shram portal showed 20,97,593 unorganised workers across 29 categories, other than agriculture and construction workers, registered in Karnataka.
cag.parameter: Coverage and completeness of the unorganised-worker database
cag.actual: 20,97,593 workers registered on the e-Shram portal

cag.finding: The Government stated that 85.81 lakh workers were registered under the e-Shram portal, while registration of the remaining 59.19 lakh workers with the State welfare mechanism was still pending.
cag.parameter: Registration of unorganised workers and convergence with State welfare schemes
cag.claimed: 85.81 lakh workers registered under the e-Shram portal
cag.actual: 59.19 lakh workers remained to be registered with the State welfare mechanism

verdict.name: e-SHRAM Portal
verdict.summary: Accountability concerns: 0 critical and 3 major findings indicate the scheme is not meeting its stated objectives.

scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
scheme.description: Pension scheme for senior citizens providing assured pension/interest income at 7.4% per annum for 10 years. Managed by LIC of India with government subsidy.
scheme.goals: Provide regular income to senior citizens post-retirement. Cover 30 lakh senior citizens. Maximum investment of Rs 15 lakh per family.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 and above

pib.headline: PMVVY extended with enhanced limit: senior citizens can invest up to Rs 15 lakh
pib.summary: Finance Ministry announces PMVVY extended to March 2023 with investment limit raised from Rs 7.5 lakh to Rs 15 lakh per family, benefiting over 30 lakh senior citizens.

pib.headline: PMVVY: 6.97 lakh policies issued, Rs 61,000 crore corpus mobilised
pib.summary: LIC announces 6.97 lakh PMVVY policies issued with total corpus of Rs 61,000 crore, providing assured pension income to senior citizens.

verdict.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
scheme.description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events. Replaced NAIS and MNAIS.
scheme.goals: Provide comprehensive risk coverage for pre-sowing to post-harvest losses. Stabilize farmers' income and encourage crop diversification. Cover 50% of all farmers.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: All farmers including sharecroppers growing notified crops

pib.headline: Kharif 2020: 5.5 crore farmers enrolled under PMFBY
pib.summary: Ministry announces 5.5 crore farmers enrolled for Kharif 2020 crop insurance, with premium subsidised by government.

pib.headline: PMFBY: Rs 1.15 lakh crore claims paid to 9 crore farmers in 5 years
pib.summary: Agriculture Ministry announces Rs 1.15 lakh crore in crop insurance claims paid to over 9 crore farmer applications under PMFBY since 2016.

pib.headline: Union Agriculture Minister Shri Tomar launches DigiClaim for claim disbursal through National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP)
pib.summary: The Ministry launched the DigiClaim module under PMFBY to electronically disburse insurance claims through the National Crop Insurance Portal. Claims totaling ₹1,260.35 crore were disbursed to insured farmers in six states on the launch date, while cumulative PMFBY claim disbursals had reached ₹1.32 lakh crore.

pib.headline: Centre launches technological advancements in crop insurance to empower farmers and streamline operations in PMFBY
pib.summary: The Ministry launched the YES-Tech Manual, WINDS portal and AIDE/Sahayak door-to-door enrollment app under PMFBY and related crop-insurance schemes. YES-Tech had been tested and piloted in 100 districts to support technology-based yield estimation and more accurate claim assessment.

pib.headline: Enrollment of Farmers and Claim Settlement under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
pib.summary: The release reported that 435 lakh farmer applications were enrolled under PMFBY during Rabi 2022-23 and 689 lakh during Kharif 2023, based on data available up to November 30, 2023. It also stated that ₹3,878 crore in claims had been paid to 7.8 lakh farmer applications for Rabi 2022-23.

pib.headline: Enrolment under PMFBY increases by 27% in the current year so far
pib.summary: The release stated that 56.80 crore farmer applications had been enrolled under PMFBY since its implementation and that more than 23.22 crore farmer applicants had received claims. Farmers had paid approximately ₹31,139 crore in premiums against claims exceeding ₹1,55,977 crore, equivalent to about ₹500 in claims for every ₹100 paid as premium.

pib.headline: Revival of Fasal Bima Yojana
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that PMFBY coverage in 2023-24 had reached an all-time high and that the scheme had become the world's largest in terms of farmer applications insured. Of ₹1,67,475 crore in reported claims, ₹1,63,519 crore, or 98%, had been paid.

pib.headline: Cabinet approves modification/addition of features and provisions in PMFBY and RWBCIS
pib.summary: The Union Cabinet approved continuation of PMFBY and RWBCIS through 2025-26 with an overall outlay of ₹69,515.71 crore for 2021-22 to 2025-26. It also approved a ₹824.77 crore Fund for Innovation and Technology to support initiatives such as YES-Tech and WINDS.

pib.headline: Insurance Claims by Farmers
pib.summary: The release provided details on crop-insurance claims under PMFBY and RWBCIS and reported that farmer applications under the schemes had reached an all-time high in 2023-24. Applications grew 35.12% year-on-year in 2022-23 and 27.50% in 2023-24.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana turns nine: Empowering Annadata and Protecting Livelihoods
pib.summary: The release marked PMFBY's ninth anniversary and described the scheme's role in protecting farmers against crop losses caused by natural calamities. It highlighted the Cabinet-approved continuation of PMFBY and RWBCIS through 2025-26 with a total budget of ₹69,515.71 crore, along with technology-based tools for crop-yield estimation and claim assessment.

pib.headline: Implementation of PMFBY
pib.summary: The Ministry reported that the number of farmers enrolled under PMFBY increased from 3.17 crore in 2022-23 to 4.19 crore in 2024-25, a 32% rise and the highest level since the scheme began. The release also noted that 6.5% of 2024-25 applications related to tenant farmers, 17.6% to marginal farmers and 48% to loanee farmers.

cag.finding: Despite three decades of Government of India efforts to provide crop insurance, coverage of farmers under the schemes continued to remain low; coverage of non-loanee farmers was particularly low because the schemes primarily targeted loanee farmers.
cag.parameter: Farmer coverage, especially non-loanee farmer coverage
cag.actual: Overall farmer coverage remained low, with particularly low coverage among non-loanee farmers.

cag.finding: The audit covered Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana and Bangla Shasya Bima for 2016-17 to 2020-21. West Bengal continued the Government of India PMFBY scheme up to December 2018, implemented the same scheme with 100 per cent State assistance up to January 2019, and introduced the 100 per cent State-sponsored Bangla Shasya Bima scheme in February 2019.
cag.parameter: Scheme implementation and transition from PMFBY to Bangla Shasya Bima
cag.actual: PMFBY implementation in West Bengal ended during the 2018-19 crop season, followed by State-funded implementation and then replacement by Bangla Shasya Bima.

verdict.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
verdict.summary: 2 major CAG findings indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.

scheme.name: Atal Pension Yojana
scheme.description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing pension of Rs 1,000–5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution.
scheme.goals: Provide social security to 4 crore unorganised sector workers by 2020. Ensure old-age income security to workers outside formal pension net.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Workers in unorganised sector aged 18-40

pib.headline: Atal Pension Yojana crosses 4 crore subscriber milestone
pib.summary: PFRDA announces APY subscriber base crosses 4 crore, with total corpus exceeding Rs 21,000 crore. Women constitute 44% of subscribers.

pib.headline: More than 6.62 crore subscribers under National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY); assets under management cross Rs. 10 lakh crore
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that the combined subscriber base of NPS and APY had exceeded 6.62 crore. Their combined assets under management also crossed Rs. 10 lakh crore.

pib.headline: Gross enrolments under Atal Pension Yojana (APY) cross 7 crore mark, with over 56 lakh enrolments in current Financial Year 2024-25
pib.summary: Total gross enrolments under APY crossed 7 crore. More than 56 lakh new enrolments were recorded during Financial Year 2024-25 at the time of the release.

pib.headline: Transformative schemes boost financial inclusion, insurance, and entrepreneurship
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance stated that APY enrolments reached 7.33 crore by January 2025. More than 89.95 lakh new APY enrolments were recorded in Financial Year 2024-25.

pib.headline: Financial inclusion schemes show substantial progress, including Atal Pension Yojana
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported that APY enrolments stood at 7.49 crore as of March 7, 2025. The release described APY as part of the government's broader financial inclusion initiatives.

pib.headline: Three Jan Suraksha Schemes complete 10 years of providing social security cover
pib.summary: The three Jan Suraksha schemes, including APY, completed ten years since their launch. More than 7.66 crore individuals had subscribed to APY as of April 23, 2025.

pib.headline: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) achieves major milestone, gross enrolments surpass 8 crore
pib.summary: Gross APY enrolments surpassed 8 crore, with 39 lakh new subscribers added during Financial Year 2025-26. The milestone coincided with the scheme's tenth anniversary.

pib.headline: PFRDA hosts Atal Pension Yojana Annual Felicitation Programme; APY marks a decade of success
pib.summary: APY gross enrolments crossed 8.11 crore as of August 21, 2025, including more than 1.17 crore new subscribers in Financial Year 2024-25. Women accounted for 55% of enrolments during that financial year.

pib.headline: Assets under Management of NPS and APY cross ₹16 lakh crore; subscriber base surpasses 9 crores
pib.summary: The combined assets under management of NPS and APY crossed ₹16 lakh crore. Their combined subscriber base also exceeded 9 crore.

pib.headline: Atal Pension Yojana reaches 8.34 crore enrolments; women account for 48%
pib.summary: The Ministry of Finance reported gross APY enrolment of 8,34,13,738 as of October 31, 2025. Women represented 48% of enrolments, while the scheme continued to provide guaranteed pension benefits after age 60.

pib.headline: Atal Pension Yojana reaches the poorest of the poor, with majority enrolments in the lower pension slab
pib.summary: A total of 8,45,17,419 subscribers had enrolled under APY as of November 30, 2025. The ₹1,000 monthly pension slab accounted for 86.91% of gross enrolments, indicating strong participation among lower-income subscribers.

pib.headline: Cabinet approves continuation of Atal Pension Yojana and extension of funding support through 2030-31
pib.summary: The Union Cabinet approved continuation of APY through Financial Year 2030-31. It also approved continued funding support for promotional and developmental activities and gap funding.

verdict.name: Atal Pension Yojana
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
scheme.description: Scheme to ensure farmers get Minimum Support Price (MSP) for their produce. Comprises Price Support Scheme, Price Deficiency Payment Scheme, and Pilot of Private Procurement.
scheme.goals: Ensure farmers get remunerative prices for their produce. Implement MSP across all notified crops. Prevent distress selling.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops across India

pib.headline: MSP hiked for all 22 kharif crops: farmers to benefit by Rs 1 lakh crore
pib.summary: Cabinet approves MSP for kharif crops with average increase of 8.6%, claiming PM-AASHA ensures farmers get remunerative prices.

pib.headline: Cabinet approves continuation of schemes of Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
pib.summary: The Union Cabinet approved continuation of the integrated PM-AASHA scheme through 2025-26 to provide remunerative prices to farmers and control price volatility for consumers. The scheme received a total financial outlay of Rs. 35,000 crore, with a 25% procurement ceiling for notified pulses, oilseeds and copra, except for 100% procurement of Tur, Urad and Masur in 2024-25.

pib.headline: Empowering Farmers Through PM-AASHA
pib.summary: Under PM-AASHA, the government procured 6.41 lakh metric tonnes of pulses during the Rabi 2023-24 season, benefiting 2.75 lakh farmers. The release states that the scheme provides price assurance for notified pulses, oilseeds and copra and supports farmers through procurement and price-deficiency mechanisms.

pib.headline: Government approves Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA) Scheme till 2025-26 during the 15th Finance Commission cycle
pib.summary: The government approved continuation of the integrated PM-AASHA scheme through 2025-26 and authorized procurement of Tur, Urad and Masur equivalent to 100% of state production for the 2024-25 procurement year. The release also reports approval for procurement of 13.22 LMT of Tur across nine states, with 0.15 LMT already procured and 12,006 farmers benefiting.

pib.headline: Measures to Reduce Dependence on Middlemen under Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
pib.summary: The release explains that PM-AASHA procurement is conducted at MSP through central nodal agencies such as NAFED and NCCF, using pre-registered farmers with legitimate land records to reduce the role of middlemen. It also states that the 25% procurement ceiling for Tur, Urad and Masur was lifted for 2023-24 and extended to 2024-25.

pib.headline: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
pib.summary: The government described PM-AASHA as an integrated scheme intended to ensure remunerative prices for farmers and affordable availability of essential commodities for consumers. Its components include the Price Support Scheme, Price Stabilisation Fund, Price Deficit Payment Scheme and Market Intervention Scheme, with procurement made directly from pre-registered farmers through designated agencies.

verdict.name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
scheme.description: Digital platform to bring 16 ministries together for integrated planning and coordinated implementation of infrastructure connectivity projects. Aims to reduce logistics cost.
scheme.goals: Integrate infrastructure planning across rail, road, ports, airports, waterways, logistics. Reduce logistics cost from 13% to 8% of GDP by 2030.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Infrastructure ministries; logistics industry; all businesses

pib.headline: PM launches Gati Shakti portal to end infrastructure silos across ministries
pib.summary: PM launches PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, a digital platform integrating 16 ministries to eliminate infrastructure duplication and reduce project delays.

pib.headline: PM Gati Shakti: Rs 25 lakh crore infrastructure projects mapped on National Master Plan
pib.summary: Commerce Ministry announces Rs 25 lakh crore worth of infrastructure projects from 16 ministries mapped on PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan portal for integrated planning.

pib.headline: Network Planning Group (NPG) under PM GatiShakti recommends 63 infrastructure projects on the Principles of PM GatiShakti
pib.summary: The Network Planning Group had recommended 63 infrastructure projects based on PM GatiShakti principles. The release explains that the National Master Plan integrates geospatial infrastructure data and supports coordinated, cost-efficient planning across Ministries and States/UTs.

pib.headline: 61st Network Planning Group Meeting under PM GatiShakti: Special review of infrastructure projects of various Ministries/Departments
pib.summary: The 61st Network Planning Group meeting reviewed the mapping of economic zones and the status of 100 critical infrastructure projects. The release reported that 39 line Ministries and 36 States/UTs had been onboarded, with 1,463 data layers uploaded to the National Master Plan platform.

pib.headline: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan to provide multimodal connectivity infrastructure to various economic zones
pib.summary: The release describes PM GatiShakti as a GIS-enabled platform integrating infrastructure and project data from the Centre and States/UTs. It says economic zones such as textile, pharmaceutical, defence, electronics, industrial, fishing and agricultural clusters are being mapped to improve connectivity, competitiveness and investment decisions.

pib.headline: PM GatiShakti: Transforming India's Infrastructure and Connectivity
pib.summary: The release presents PM GatiShakti as a multimodal connectivity initiative launched in 2021 to support infrastructure planning and economic growth. It highlights the use of integrated data, district-level planning and coordinated development to strengthen connectivity and support manufacturing and investment.

pib.headline: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan completes 3 years of transforming India's Infrastructure landscape
pib.summary: The release reports that PM GatiShakti has improved infrastructure planning, project execution and service delivery through geospatial integration and a whole-of-government approach. More than 44 Central Ministries and 36 States/UTs had been onboarded, with over 1,600 data layers integrated and more than 200 major projects evaluated.

pib.headline: 83 meetings of Network Planning Group held so far with projects worth Rs 15.89 lakh cr
pib.summary: The Network Planning Group had held 83 meetings and evaluated 228 infrastructure projects with an estimated cumulative cost of ₹15.89 lakh crore. The release also describes progress under the National Logistics Policy and the launch of a beta District Master Plan for 27 aspirational districts under PM GatiShakti.

pib.headline: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan Evaluates 293 Infrastructure Projects Worth ₹13.59 Lakh Crore
pib.summary: The release states that 293 infrastructure projects worth ₹13.59 lakh crore had been evaluated through the Network Planning Group mechanism. It also reports that 57 Central Ministries/Departments and all 36 States/UTs had been onboarded, with about 1,700 data layers integrated on the platform.

cag.finding: Sixteen AC bills involving ₹62.04 crore, drawn on 31 March 2023 for construction of 13 jetties on the Hooghly River and three helipads in different districts for multimodal connectivity under Gati Shakti NMP, remained unadjusted till August 2023.
cag.parameter: Adjustment of AC bills for multimodal connectivity works under Gati Shakti NMP
cag.actual: ₹62.04 crore remained unadjusted in 16 AC bills till August 2023

verdict.name: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
verdict.summary: 1 major CAG finding indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.

scheme.name: PM Daksh Yojana
scheme.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scheme.description: Scheme for upskilling of marginalised youth — SCs, OBCs, EBCs, DNTs, and sanitation workers. Provides short-term and long-term skill training with stipend and placement support.
scheme.goals: Train 50,000 youth annually. Ensure 60% placement post training. Cover SCs, OBCs, EBCs, Safai Karamcharis, Denotified Tribes.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Marginalised youth: SCs, OBCs, EBCs, sanitation workers aged 18-45

pib.headline: PM Daksh: 50,000 marginalised youth trained in FY 2021-22
pib.summary: Social Justice Ministry announces PM Daksh Yojana trained 50,000 SC/OBC/EBC/sanitation worker youth in FY22 across 1,000 training programmes with 60% placement rate claimed.

pib.headline: PM Daksh portal: 2.7 lakh candidates registered for skill training
pib.summary: Ministry announces 2.7 lakh candidates registered on PM Daksh portal for free skill training, with 500 empanelled training partners across India.

pib.headline: The Pradhan Mantri Dakshata Aur Kushalata Sampanna Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) Yojana
pib.summary: The release describes PM-DAKSH’s target groups, eligibility criteria, training formats, stipends and wage compensation. It reports that 107,120 beneficiaries were trained during 2020-21 to 2022-23 and sets a target to train 169,300 candidates during 2023-24 to 2025-26.

pib.headline: PM-DAKSH Yojana
pib.summary: The scheme provides skill training to SC, OBC, DNT, EWS and sanitation-worker groups to improve their prospects for wage and self-employment. It was approved with an outlay of Rs. 450 crore for 2021-22 to 2025-26, including a 2024-25 budget estimate of Rs. 130 crore.

pib.headline: PM-Daksh Yojana National Action Plan Aims to Skill 169,300 persons from Marginalized Community till 2025-26
pib.summary: The backgrounder explains that PM-DAKSH provides long- and short-term training, upskilling and entrepreneurship development for marginalized communities. It reports 107,120 trainees and 77,237 placements during 2020-21 to 2022-23, with 169,300 additional trainees targeted through 2025-26.

pib.headline: YEAR-END REVIEW 2024: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
pib.summary: The department’s year-end review reports that 80,185 beneficiaries received PM-DAKSH training during 2023-24. The training was delivered through 112 empanelled training institutes.

pib.headline: Parliament Question: Impact of PM-Daksh Yojana
pib.summary: The release states that PM-DAKSH was approved for five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 and is subject to monitoring and independent evaluation. It reports 187,305 beneficiaries under the scheme up to 2023-24 and an allocation of Rs. 80 crore for 2024-25 at the revised-estimate stage.

pib.headline: Objectives of PM-DAKSH Yojana
pib.summary: The release outlines PM-DAKSH’s objective of improving the employability of SC, OBC, DNT, EWS and sanitation-worker groups through skills training. The scheme has an approved outlay of Rs. 450 crore for 2021-22 to 2025-26, including a 2025-26 budget estimate of Rs. 130 crore.

pib.headline: Skill Training under PM-DAKSH Scheme
pib.summary: The release reports that 187,305 individuals had received skill training under PM-DAKSH. Of these, 73,102 beneficiaries, or 39 percent, had received wage or self-employment, while the scheme’s guidelines require training institutes to pursue employment outcomes.

pib.headline: Welfare Schemes
pib.summary: The release provides state-wise PM-DAKSH training data and describes the scheme’s implementation through empanelled institutes. It states that 73,150 trainees had obtained wage or self-employment after completing training and notes a separate entrepreneurship-development project for 1,800 transgender persons.

verdict.name: PM Daksh Yojana
verdict.summary: No CAG audit findings are available for this scheme yet.

scheme.name: Make in India
scheme.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
scheme.description: Initiative to facilitate investment, foster innovation, enhance skill development, protect intellectual property, and build best-in-class manufacturing infrastructure.
scheme.goals: Increase manufacturing sector growth rate to 12-14% per annum. Increase share of manufacturing in GDP from 16% to 25% by 2025. Create 100 million additional jobs by 2022.
scheme.targetBeneficiaries: Domestic and foreign manufacturers; investors across 25 sectors

pib.headline: Manufacturing GDP share reaches 17.4%: Make in India on track
pib.summary: DPIIT claims manufacturing contribution to GDP has risen to 17.4%, progressing towards 25% target under Make in India initiative.

pib.headline: FDI inflows hit record $83.6 billion in 2021-22 under Make in India
pib.summary: Commerce Ministry announces FDI inflows reached all-time high of $83.6 billion in 2021-22, attributing growth to Make in India policy framework.

pib.headline: Make in India initiative to make India a hub for manufacturing, design and innovation
pib.summary: The release says foreign direct investment equity inflow in the manufacturing sector increased by 57% during 2014–2022 compared with 2006–2014, attributing the rise to the Make in India initiative. It also describes policy measures including PLI schemes, investment facilitation, and initiatives to strengthen domestic manufacturing. ([pib.gov.in](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1947211))

pib.headline: 2023 Year End Review for Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
pib.summary: The DPIIT year-end review reports that Make in India 2.0 is focused on 27 sectors to develop India as a manufacturing hub. It also highlights PLI progress, including more than ₹95,000 crore in reported investment, ₹7.80 lakh crore in production or sales, and over 6.4 lakh direct and indirect jobs through September 2023. ([pib.gov.in](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1990377))

pib.headline: Business Reforms Action Plan 2024 to further strengthen Make in India; bring seamless business regulatory framework across India
pib.summary: DPIIT announced BRAP 2024 to strengthen the Make in India initiative by creating a more seamless and efficient business regulatory framework. The plan emphasizes reducing approval times, expanding online service delivery, reducing compliance burdens, and using digital platforms to improve India’s investment environment. ([pib.gov.in](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2060200))

pib.headline: Advancing industrial growth and empowering local economy main focus of DPIIT in the first 100 days of government
pib.summary: The release describes DPIIT initiatives supporting Make in India, including 12 new world-class industrial smart cities under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme. It also highlights PM Ekta Malls for local products and a Public Procurement (Make in India) Order requiring items with sufficient domestic capacity to be sourced from local suppliers. ([pib.gov.in](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2062126))

pib.headline: 2024 Year End Review for Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
pib.summary: The DPIIT year-end review reports major manufacturing achievements under the PLI scheme, which supports the Make in India and self-reliance agenda. It records ₹1.46 lakh crore in investment, ₹12.50 lakh crore in production or sales, ₹4 lakh crore in exports, and 9.5 lakh direct and indirect jobs. ([pib.gov.in](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2086347))

cag.finding: The audit found that the automated system for the Merchandise Exports from India Scheme (MEIS) and Service Exports from India Scheme (SEIS), introduced under the Foreign Trade Policy 2015-20 with a Make in India vision, had shortcomings and required manual intervention. This caused avoidable physical interface and discretion, resulting in delays and failure to achieve simplification and ease-of-doing-business objectives. During April 2015 to October 2018, 5,94,653 scrips amounting to ₹76,416 crore were issued.
cag.parameter: MEIS/SEIS export-incentive scrip issuance, automation and ease of doing business
cag.actual: 5,94,653 scrips amounting to ₹76,416 crore were issued; the audit found shortcomings and gaps in automation, manual intervention and resulting delays.

verdict.name: Make in India
verdict.summary: 1 major CAG finding indicate gaps between PIB claims and actual implementation.
